b:
The one who lived in moonlight
alone
in a cloudless red sky

Those I spent time with,
those who stood by me,
grew distant

A few new relationships,
and even in closeness
a hesitation

A permanent
gap
that cannot be filled

The wall of self-confidence
slowly began to crack

No shoulders
to hold me up

The dried
tracks of tears
were not visible
to any eyes

When I did not stand
in their pain,
why expect them
in mine?

When I
lost myself,
a tiny voice
brought me back

Her
baby talk
made me enjoy
even medicine

Today
the degree I receive
is for
the words
she let fall
that day

My dedication,
to the six-year-old girl
who changed
those
six years
